allow: PowerShell($processes = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; if \($processes\) { $processes | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host "Killed PID: $_" } } else { Write-Host "No process on port 5000" })
